blindSummary:
An overseas collectivity of a distant metropolitan state; that state's national law applies here in full; a luxury tourism enclave; thin data.

The risk profile is the metropolitan state's own, slightly modified by the enclave character noted above.
blindOutOfScope: An overseas territory of a distant metropolitan state; local deviations are noted in the summary.
blindSourceSummaries: News feature (Jan 2018): trans women incarcerated in the metropolitan state on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area and are punished beyond their alleged crimes - relevant to this territory because it applies the metropolitan state's law directly.

Opinion of 25 May 2021 by the metropolitan state's national detention-monitoring body on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty: based on ~40 referrals since 2010, it finds serious violations of fundamental rights persist across places of detention, with recommendations applicable also to intersex and non-binary persons.

Online encyclopedia article on transgender rights in this territory: the metropolitan state's national law applies - legal gender-marker change without surgery/sterilization (2016 reform), gender-affirming care available since 1975, anti-discrimination protections extended to gender identity; no non-binary recognition; reported to attract trans migrants from two nearby overseas territories of the same metropolitan state seeking a more accepting environment; healthcare access limited by the territory's small size.

LGBT destination guide (verified April 2026): this island as a discreet luxury destination - 'full legal protections under the metropolitan state's law', a cosmopolitan crowd that 'genuinely doesn't care', no organised gay scene but a completely safe environment for same-sex couples; a commercial safety index scores it 8.6.

Trans-rights rating organisation's country page for this territory: trans-rights overview scoring 7.7/10 - legal gender change without surgery (per the metropolitan state's law, since 2017), judicial process possibly involving medical evaluation, no non-binary recognition, same-sex marriage legal since May 2013, anti-discrimination laws in place, limited local healthcare access; no government LGBT travel advice; no trans-specific community travel advice submitted.
Gay travel agency blog: a marketing guide asking whether this island is gay-friendly - a travel-agency perspective presenting it as a welcoming luxury destination for gay couples.
